581915.title: SV-11575 - Tech View and Board View offer a Technician filter that List does not
581915.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three technicians are active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on, added in this order: {Technician-A}, {Technician-B}, {Technician-C}.
    For example: {Technician-A} is Ana Carter, {Technician-B} is Ana Brooks and {Technician-C} is Ben Adams.
  • Technician {Technician-D} is deactivated at {Location-A} and still leads at least one work order there, so Tech View shows their group marked "Inactive".
    For example: {Technician-D} is Aimee Francis.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
581915.custom_steps:
1. Look at the filter bar.
  2. Click "Technician".
  3. Type the name of {Technician-D} in "Search technician".
  4. Clear the "Search technician" box.
  5. Tick {Technician-A}, then tick {Technician-B}.
  6. Click "Clear selection".
  7. Press Escape.
  8. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  9. Click "Technician".
  10. Press Escape.
  11. Click "List" in the display switcher.
581915.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a "Technician" filter sits right after "Assigned to me". There is no Department, Customer or Service Advisor filter.
  • Step 2: the list starts with "Unassigned". The active technicians follow, by first name then last name: {Technician-B}, then {Technician-A}, then {Technician-C}, whatever order they were added in. Deactivated technicians come after every active one, each with the grey "Inactive" label.
  • Step 3: {Technician-D} is found, with the grey "Inactive" label.
  • Step 4: the whole list shows again.
  • Step 5: {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are both ticked at the same time, and Tech View shows only their two groups.
  • Step 6: nothing is ticked.
  • Step 7: the list closes and every technician group shows again.
  • Step 8: Board View shows the same columns as Tech View had groups.
  • Step 9: the "Technician" filter sits in the same place, right after "Assigned to me", with the same options in the same order as in step 2, {Technician-D} included with "Inactive".
  • Step 10: the list closes.
  • Step 11: List shows no "Technician" filter.

Known problem (SV-11575, In Progress; Bilal Muzamil, staging build v26.40.20-0509710, 20 Oct 2026): technicians who have their own group or column but are deactivated or no longer enrolled are missing from the Technician list (for example Aimee Francis: her column is marked Inactive, but typing her name in "Search technician" gives No results). (1) If you see exactly that at steps 2, 3 or 9, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If {Technician-D} is listed with "Inactive", mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); tickets SV-11326 and SV-11575

  • S1-R15: “In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then everyone who gets a group or column at this location: the location’s technicians (S9-R4), and any lead technician who keeps a column while still leading work orders here (deactivated, S2-N2 and S3-N2; not enrolled here, S3-R20b; Time Clock turned off, S3-R20d). Active technicians come first, by first name then last name, then deactivated technicians, by first name then last name, each with the same grey “Inactive” label as their column. Someone who no longer gets a group or column is not listed. Choosing one or more shows only those technicians’ groups or columns; every other group or column, pinned ones included, is hidden. It filters by lead technician only.”
  • S1-R15b: “List does not offer the Technician filter and stays as in production. Switching to List while technicians are chosen shows List as if none were chosen; switching back to Tech View or Board View brings the choice back. The choice is remembered the same way as the other filters.”
  • Out of Scope: “A Department filter. The design shows one, but a work order’s department is not shown or editable on any work order screen today, so users could not see why a work order matches. Revisit once the work order shows its department.”
  • Out of Scope: “The Customer and Service Advisor filter chips production retired in the redesign (SV-8785) are not brought back.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11575)

698883.title: SV-11575 - Opening the Technician list never shows the 50-value limit message
698883.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Location-A} has at least one technician.
    For example: Esther Howard.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Tech View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
698883.custom_steps:
1. Click "Technician".
  2. Look at the bottom of the list that opens, above "Clear selection".
  3. Tick "Unassigned".
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Click "Board View" in the display switcher.
  6. Click "Technician".
  7. Untick "Unassigned" and look at the bottom of the list again.
698883.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the list opens, starting with "Unassigned".
  • Step 2: the message "This change would exceed the 50-value limit across all filters" does not show.
  • Step 3: "Unassigned" is ticked and the message does not show.
  • Step 4: the list closes.
  • Step 5: Board View shows.
  • Step 6: the Board View list opens with "Unassigned" still ticked, and the message does not show.
  • Step 7: nothing is ticked and the message does not show.

Known problem (SV-11575, In Progress; Bilal Muzamil, staging build v26.40.20-0509710, 20 Oct 2026): as soon as the Technician list opens, with nothing ticked, the red message "This change would exceed the 50-value limit across all filters" shows at the bottom of the list, in Tech View and Board View, and also while typing in "Search technician". (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Blocked by SV-11575 (the QA lead's instruction, 20 Oct 2026) and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If the message never shows, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); ticket SV-11575

  • S1-R15c: “The filters’ 50-value limit message, “This change would exceed the 50-value limit across all filters”, shows only when a tick would take the total across all filters over 50 values, and that tick is not applied. It never shows just because the Technician list is opened, or while the total is 50 or fewer.”

682422.title: More actions reads Assign lead technician when a work order has no lead
682422.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technician {Technician-A} is active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: {Technician-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682422 Ana.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has two Approved work orders: {Work-order-1} with no lead technician, and {Work-order-2} led by {Technician-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682422 Assign Wording, and {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} are S2-37401 and S2-37402.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
682422.custom_steps:
1. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1} in "Unassigned".
  2. Click "Assign lead technician".
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-2} in {Technician-A}'s column.
  5. Click "Reassign lead technician".
  6. Click "Cancel".
  7. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the row for {Work-order-1} in "Unassigned".
  9. Click "Assign lead technician".
  10. Click "Cancel".
682422.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu offers "Assign lead technician". It does not say "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 2: a dialog titled "Assign lead technician" opens.
  • Step 3: the dialog closes and {Work-order-1} stays in "Unassigned".
  • Step 4: the menu offers "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 5: a dialog titled "Reassign lead technician" opens.
  • Step 6: the dialog closes and {Work-order-2} stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 7: Tech View shows {Work-order-1} in "Unassigned" and {Work-order-2} in {Technician-A}'s group.
  • Step 8: the menu offers "Assign lead technician". It does not say "Reassign lead technician".
  • Step 9: a dialog titled "Assign lead technician" opens.
  • Step 10: the dialog closes and {Work-order-1} stays in "Unassigned".

Developers also check this with unit tests (SV-11570): WorkOrderMoreActions.spec.ts ("the lead action's label") and ReassignLeadTechnicianDialog.spec.ts ("its title and confirm button").

Known problem (SV-11570, Testing QA, for this release; it replaces SV-11522 and SV-11524 for the label only, Chris Ward, Slack #fs-board-tech-view, 20 Oct 2026): until it ships, the menu on a work order with no lead says "Reassign lead technician". (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the change has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician) and SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician from the board or grouped table); ticket SV-11570

  • S3-R14: “Include the lead technician action in the card’s more-actions menu: “Assign lead technician” on a work order with no lead technician, “Reassign lead technician” on one that has a lead technician.”
  • S4-R4: “The card or row more-actions menu opens the lead technician dialog, titled “Assign lead technician” or “Reassign lead technician” to match the menu item it was opened from (S3-R14).”
  • S4-R13: “Clicking a technician in the dialog assigns them at once; there is no confirm button, and the dialog’s only button is Cancel. When the shift-clearing prompt applies (S4-R28) it shows first, and the change is made from the prompt. Clicking the work order’s current lead closes the dialog with no change (S4-N4).”

new.title: Board View has no Density control and Column Selection sits centred
new.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Location-A} has at least one technician and one work order.
    For example: Esther Howard.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
new.custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar between the filters and the display switcher.
  2. Click "Column Selection".
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  5. Click the density button in the toolbar.
new.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no density button. "Column Selection" sits centred between the toolbar's two dividers, with no empty gap or double divider where the density button was.
  • Step 2: the picker of card fields opens, the same picker "Fields to display" opened before.
  • Step 3: the picker closes and the cards keep their usual spacing.
  • Step 4: Tech View shows, and its toolbar still has the density button.
  • Step 5: the menu offers "Compact", "Regular" and "Comfortable".

Known problem (SV-11580, Open): until it ships, Board View still shows the density button and the field picker is named "Fields to display". (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results say, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the change has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician), SV-10048 (Story 5, Column Selection) and SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); ticket SV-11580

  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580). Column Selection sits centered between the toolbar’s two dividers, with no empty gap where Density was. A Card size control as in the design (Compact and Detailed) follows as a fast follow (SV-11581).”
  • S5-R2: “Board View offers a separate Column Selection picker in the same toolbar position and with the same interaction as the column chooser.”
  • S6-E1: “Density applies to Tech View rows on Work Orders; Board View cards keep their current spacing in this release. List keeps today’s row size, and other application tables are unchanged.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).”
  • PRD change log, 20 Oct 2026: “Fields to display renamed Column Selection everywhere it appears, the same name the other views use. v71.”
